brief: Reduce array entries to a single value
description: Call callbackfn for each entry of array, in index order, with the accumulator and that entry; each call's result is the accumulator for the next call. If initialValue is passed, it is the first accumulator and every entry is visited; otherwise the first entry is the first accumulator and the walk starts at the second. Undefined entries are visited. An empty array with no initialValue is an error.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (accumulator: any, value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => any
parameters.description: Called for each entry visited; its result is the next accumulator. A script function is called with (accumulator, value, index, array); a built-in function is called with (accumulator, value).
parameters.name: callbackfn

parameters.description: The first accumulator. When it is not passed, the first entry of array is.
parameters.name: initialValue

returns.description: The last result of callbackfn, or the initial accumulator if callbackfn is not called.
